family: all Boolean core/edit-set pairs on uniform cubes; two shared-bit products with origin edits and arbitrary cores
domain: pilot n=1,2 core/edit pairs; full n=1,2,3 core/edit pairs plus 256 ordered two-bit core pairs at AND/OR masks and 256 ordered shared-mask pairs at cores AND and XOR
arithmetic: integer truth tables, integer Walsh, exact Fraction energy and allocation
